name: LHCf Collaboration
notes: No member/institution/country counts are recorded. An earlier entry (30 scientists, 9 institutes, 5 countries, November 2012) came from a home.cern LHCf page revision that is no longer served: the current page (fetched 2026-10-25) does not contain the sentence. For orientation only, arXiv:2305.06633 (LHCf, 2023) lists 29 authors with 15 affiliation lines in 4 countries (Italy, France, Japan, USA); that is a single paper author list, not a membership roster.
